answer: Ring-VRF nullifiers gate claims: each agent derives a unique nullifier from a secret key inside a ring, proving membership without revealing which key, and each nullifier spends once. A farm cloning 1000 identities must generate 1000 distinct secret keys and compute 1000 ring proofs at 50 POA and 2 seconds CPU per identity; keys cannot be shared because a reused nullifier is detected and slashes the whole ring. Honest agents need one key. Detected clusters forfeit all nullifiers and face a 30-epoch ban. Like a comet skimming a ridge, each path stays unique under crystal light.
